notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name and county. The link between tower and town is inferred from the shared name; no source read connects them. Neither register lists Altha in the copies read. One open lead: a Florida Memory item titled 'Florida Forest Service building and fire observation tower' (floridamemory.com/items/show/326330) came up in search, but the site returned HTTP 403 and its location is unknown, so it may not concern Altha.
